# Scrappy Car

> Scrappy Car is a locally owned scrap car removal company in Scarborough, Ontario, run by co-owners Marce Anthony and Ryan Basalt. We buy junk cars in any condition for cash, with free towing and same-day pickup across Scarborough, Pickering, Ajax, Whitby, Oshawa, Markham, North York, East Toronto and the rest of the GTA.

- Phone: (647) 204-4200
- Address: 125 Island Rd, Scarborough, ON M1C 4Z2, Canada
- Hours: 7:00 am to 9:00 pm, 7 days a week
- Payment: cash on the spot at pickup
- Towing: always free, included in the offer
- Typical offers: most vehicles get $200 to $1,500+, depending on year, make, model, weight, condition and current scrap metal prices
- Condition: any. Running, not running, accident damaged, rusted, flood damaged, missing parts
- Paperwork: Ontario vehicle ownership (permit) is required to transfer the vehicle. Lost ownership can be replaced at ServiceOntario; we help with the process

## Service areas

- Scarborough, including Port Union, West Rouge, Rouge Hill, Highland Creek, Malvern, Agincourt
- Durham Region: Pickering, Ajax, Whitby, Oshawa
- Markham, North York, East Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area
